title: EC2 Fundamentals
summary: What Amazon EC2 is and the choices you make when you launch an instance: operating system, instance type, storage, security groups and a user data bootstrap script. Learn to read instance type names, pick the right family, write security group rules (including references to other groups), and connect with SSH, PuTTY or EC2 Instance Connect.
